rules.rule: Do not require failed Luma attempts before using a Codex original-generation exception.

rules.quote: Ordinary objects and surrounding environments retain the Luma default.
rules.rule: Use Luma for ordinary objects and surrounding environments.

rules.quote: When a subagent or background job runs long, check it proactively for stalls.
rules.rule: When a subagent or background job runs long, proactively check it for stalls instead of waiting for its completion notification.

rules.quote: Look at real signals: output file timestamps, running render and ffmpeg processes, log tails.
rules.rule: When checking a long-running job for stalls, use real signals such as output file timestamps, running render and ffmpeg processes, and log tails.

rules.quote: Don't just wait for the completion notification.
rules.rule: Do not rely solely on the completion notification to learn that a long-running job has finished or stalled.

rules.quote: When delegating a long job, set a fallback check: ScheduleWakeup, or a check after my next piece of work.
rules.rule: When delegating a long job, set a fallback check using ScheduleWakeup or a check after the next piece of work.

rules.quote: If outputs haven't changed in 10+ minutes, inspect the job.
rules.rule: If a job's outputs have not changed in 10 or more minutes, inspect the job.

rules.quote: Tell agents to wait on a PID or an output file, never on `pgrep -f <name>` when `<name>` appears in the waiting command itself.
rules.rule: Tell delegated agents to wait on a PID or an output file, never on `pgrep -f <name>` when `<name>` appears in the waiting command itself.

rules.quote:
Stall checks must watch the delegated session's own transcript file (find it by its brief text), never "the
  newest .jsonl in the project dir".
rules.rule: Stall checks must watch the delegated session's own transcript file, found by its brief text, never the newest .jsonl in the project directory.

rules.quote: When a stage completes, stop its monitors at once (TaskStop).
rules.rule: When a stage completes, stop its monitors immediately using TaskStop.

rules.quote: **Never hand-install fal results by grabbing "the first image URL" in a fal_run log**
rules.rule: Never hand-install fal results by grabbing the first image URL in a fal_run log.

rules.quote: Take the URL from the log's `response` field only (as luma_batch does), or re-run through the tool.
rules.rule: When getting a fal result URL, take it from the log's `response` field only, or re-run through the tool.

rules.quote: running luma_batch without `--only` regenerates any entry it thinks is missing
rules.rule: Do not run luma_batch without `--only`, since it regenerates any entry it thinks is missing.
